props.text: From routine maintenance, upgrades and accessory installs, to damage repairs, Truck Country/Stoops can handle the job. With multiple locations offering onsite service for light duty and commercial trailers, we get you back on the road fast. We are proud to service the best trailers in the industry including MAC Trailer, Stoughton, Wabash, and Transcraft/Benson, to name a few.
Decaling up to Including Full Wraps
Install Skirt, Wings, and Other Aerodynamic Devices
Replacing Partial and up to Full Roofs
Install Lift Gates and Lift Pads
Repair and Install Brakes and Systems

Count on Stoops’ On-Site Mobile Trailer Service to get you back on the road. Whether for emergency breakdowns, roadside repair, preventive maintenance, DOT inspections, or scheduled onsite repairs, our Mobile Service Truck is ready and at your service!
Preventative Maintenance - FHWA inspections, repair DOT (Violations), etc.
Brakes - Replace brake shoes/drums, adjust brakes, replace wheel seals
Electrical - Repair/replace lights/wiring, ABS diagnostics, troubleshooting
Body Work - Roof/panel patches, repair/replace swing and roll-up doors, repair/replace landing gear
Suspension - Slider pins, airbags, brake chambers, air valves, shocks

Truck Country/Stoops has the trailer parts and accessories you need to get the most out of your trailer. We offer a huge selection of cross-application trailer parts such as: tail lights, tires, wheels, axles, leaf springs, frame hardware, tongue jacks, couplers, safety chains, towing equipment, brakes and much more from top name brand manufacturers.
